principle: The independent critic uses lexical anchors, data shapes and a small list of suspicious expressions. It is not an entailment or contradiction oracle.

probes.source: 관찰 중 실내 온도 변화는 기록하지 않았다.
probes.counterexample: Both frozen lexical anchors 실내 and 기록 are present even though negation flips.

candidate.sentence: 20분 뒤 감싼 병의 물 온도가 더 높았다.

probes.source: 20분 뒤 천으로 감싼 병의 물 온도가 다른 병보다 낮았다.

probes.counterexample: Agent and object anchors still match when the action reverses.

implication: Do not use KRC v0.2 V acceptance as semantic correctness evidence. A separate NLI-grade evidence court and human checks are necessary; do not optimize a model against blind human ratings or fix this retrospectively on the same generated texts.
next_prospective_design: Introduce typed predicate polarity and argument entailment checks based on source proposition decomposition, with explicit UNKNOWN and adversarial controls, before claiming factual soundness.
